summary: H06G maps every assigned recovery, live-acceptance and governance clause while preserving final host, platform and production gates.
facts: All four task acceptance clauses and all six assigned requirement clauses are mapped to reviewed, executed facts.
No H06G evidence claims production installation, scheduler ownership, live-host completion, native Windows or final R2 acceptance.

acceptance.clause: 生命体在 5 秒内报告卡顿并在能力边界内处理孤儿锁、退出 actor、冲突 lane 与 runtime drift
acceptance.fact: H06G prevents a hostile or drifted release inventory from being hashed, granted or staged; accepted liveness ownership remains with H03 and final runtime observation remains an H06H gate.

acceptance.clause: 干预有预算、有终态、有 receipt，不能扩大 allowed paths、静默换宿主或无限重试
acceptance.fact: The managed task used one Codex provider, five exact paths and terminal receipts; unknown, reordered and aliased inputs fail before filesystem or effects and cannot expand maintenance authority.

acceptance.clause: I01-I19、并发、进程死亡、receipt tamper、world-state drift、只读账本、scheduler degraded 与 rollback 全部通过
acceptance.fact: H06G proves the release-inventory, staged-artifact, tamper and installer rollback subset only; the complete I01-I19 and concurrent fleet run remains a final H06H obligation.

acceptance.clause: Codex 与 Claude 真实宿主、macOS 与 Windows 证据齐全前不得宣称 R2 完成或 production accepted
acceptance.fact: The macOS candidate and integrated suites pass, but the native Windows PowerShell test is explicitly skipped and no live host or production claim is made.

acceptance.clause: H00-H06 均有严格 owned paths、证据包、finding 处置和独立 reviewer，失败候选不合并
acceptance.fact: H06G retained run1 and repair1 findings, used five frozen paths, passed three independent reviews, and integrated only byte-identical repair2 outputs before evidence promotion.

acceptance.clause: G0-G6/T32 accepted 历史不被重建、重放或改写
acceptance.fact: H06G ran in an independent full clone and integrated only into the R2 coordinator branch; accepted predecessor events, dev/main, installed runtime and production state were not rewritten.
